pool.text: The city was depicted standing between Mount Zuqualla and Menegasha on a map.
Ahmad ibn Ibrahim plundered the city while the imperial army was trapped.
Settlement began in the valley south of the mountain in Finfinne.
Addis Ababa became the empire's capital, leading to international embassies opening.
St George's Cathedral was founded and serves as a museum home.
Gebrehiwot Baykedagn took a major administrative division post and railways.
A wide-scale economic boom occurred with increased middle class buildings.
The Emperor was crowned and proceeded with new technologies and building infrastructure.
Italian troops entered Addis Ababa following major engagements of their invasion.
Major Orde Wingate and Emperor Haile Selassie liberated the city.
Haile Selassie invited Sir Patrick Abercrombie with goals of modelling the city.
The National Palace was built to mark Emperor Haile Selassie's Silver Jubilee.
The United Nations Economic Commission for Africa was founded with its headquarters.
Haile Selassie helped to form the Organisation of African Unity.
The first student march took place in response to the feudal imperial government.
The Derg nationalized extra rental structures built by private stockholders.
The Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front seized Addis Ababa.
The construction of the Addis Ababa Ring Road was initiated.
Oromia's capital was moved from Addis Ababa to Adama.
Addis Ababa Zoo kept 15 lions.
